title: World-T3: Test-Time Training as Persistent Memory for Real-Time Video World Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.17434v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in video world models have enabled plausible interactive environments, yet long-horizon generation places a fundamental demand on visual memory: the previously observed world must remain consistent as the model continues to generate. Existing autoregressive approaches often implicitly rely on the generative model itself to retain such information, leading to spatial memory decay beyond the active context. We introduce World-T3, a camera-controlled video world model with a test-time training memory that consolidates past observations into dedicated model parameters. To robustly update this memory, we propose a recursive least-squares rule that incrementally absorbs novel visual features via online pose-keyed memory updates. Our TTT memory reads out previously observed scene features from the fast-weight state by camera pose, enabling consistent generation with constant storage and per-step computation regardless of rollo

translated_title: World-T3：将测试时训练作为实时视频世界模型的持久记忆
translated_abstract: 视频世界模型的最新进展已经能够生成逼真的交互式环境，然而长时程生成对视觉记忆提出了根本性要求：先前观察到的世界必须在模型持续生成的过程中保持一致。现有的自回归方法往往隐式地依赖生成模型本身来保留这类信息，导致在活跃上下文之外出现空间记忆衰减。我们提出World-T3，一个具备测试时训练（TTT）记忆的相机可控视频世界模型，它将过去的观察结果整合到专用的模型参数中。为了稳健地更新这一记忆，我们提出一种递归最小二乘规则，通过在线的、以相机位姿为键的记忆更新，逐步吸收新的视觉特征。我们的TTT记忆通过相机位姿从快速权重状态中读出先前观察到的场景特征，无论回滚（rollover）情况如何，都能以恒定的存储和每步计算实现一致的生成。
tldr: World-T3提出一种以测试时训练（TTT）为持久记忆的机制，借助递归最小二乘规则和相机位姿键控的在线记忆更新，使实时视频世界模型在长时程生成中保持空间一致性，且存储与每步计算成本恒定。
en_tdlr: World-T3 employs test-time training as persistent memory, using a recursive least-squares rule with pose-keyed online updates to keep past observations consistent in long-horizon video world model generation with constant storage and per-step computation.
